name: vitesse-nuxt-monorepo
description: Hardened Nuxt and Express monorepo template based on antfu's Vitesse Nuxt
author: Jacob Anderson

scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end build
scripts.build:netlify: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.lint-server: npm run -w back-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run -w front-end lint && npm run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: eslint "*.{js,ts,mjs,cjs}" scripts netlify --fix && npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w front-end typecheck && npm run -w back-end typecheck && tsc -p netlify/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run -w back-end test && npm run test:build-toolchain && npm run test:http-compat && node --test scripts/test-archiver-compat.mjs scripts/test-glob-compat.mjs scripts/test-listhen-compat.mjs scripts/test-braces-compat.mjs scripts/test-deepmerge-compat.mjs scripts/test-qs-compat.mjs scripts/test-vendored-qs-packaging.mjs scripts/test-vue-devtools-compat.mjs scripts/test-toolchain-compat.mjs scripts/test-native-bindings.mjs scripts/test-frontend-command.mjs scripts/test-devtools-provider.mjs && npm run test:devtools && npm run test:vue-jsx && npm run test:router-compiler && npm run test:remove && npm run test:magicast && npm run test:vue-compiler && npm run test:checker && npm run test:rollup-compat && npm run test:nitro-tools && npm run test:nft && npm run test:watchers && npm run test:unimport-source && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_unhead_compat.py -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_runtime_artifact.py -v && npm run test:toolchain-package

scripts.test:rollup-compat: node --test scripts/test-rollup-compat.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_rollup_compat.py -v
